decision_rule: Code whether construct-relevant AI could contribute to the scored response at the moment the response was produced.
unclear_rule: Use unclear when the report does not explicitly establish access/restriction at the focal assessment.
minimum_source_evidence: Explicit methods/procedure statement or directly described assessment environment.
example: Proctored paper exam with AI prohibited -> removed.

decision_rule: Record exact elapsed time from the final relevant assisted exposure when reported; otherwise use concurrent/immediate/unclear.
allowed_values: concurrent | immediate | exact elapsed time | unclear
unclear_rule: Use unclear when timing relative to the final assisted exposure cannot be reconstructed.
minimum_source_evidence: Timeline, procedure, or dated session description.
example: Post-test one week after intervention -> 7 days.

decision_rule: Classify overlap between supported material and assessed material without inferring transfer from novelty alone.
unclear_rule: Use unclear when task correspondence is not described sufficiently.
minimum_source_evidence: Item/task descriptions or explicit statement of repeated/isomorphic/new material.
example: Same three pretest items reused -> repeated.

decision_rule: Code the intended generalization demand beyond the supported task, separately from item novelty.
unclear_rule: Use unclear when a transfer interpretation is asserted without enough task/context detail to classify it.
example: New but isomorphic algebra items -> near.

dimension: Evidence and scope of AI non-use
decision_rule: Record how non-use/restriction was established and what AI functions were restricted.
unclear_rule: Use unclear when AI absence is assumed but neither procedure nor verification is reported.
minimum_source_evidence: Proctoring, device restriction, logging, monitoring, explicit self-report, or equivalent evidence.
example: Supervised lab with no external sources -> prevented/monitored, scope documented.
